notes.title: One Year Anniversary! New heads available for free!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/e1f4ea7474e02ad71185ac39625e708652816867.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing “CUSTOM MECH WARS".

Thanks to all of you, “CUSTOM MECH WARS” celebrates its first anniversary. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all those who have played the game.

To commemorate this event, we have released a new DLC “Head parts: Girl head B’”. It is available free of charge.
*This is another version of “Girl head”. The head antenna attached to the “Girl head A” has been removed, but the performance is the same.

We look forward to your continued support of "CUSTOM MECH WARS".

notes.title: Plans for Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Custom Mech Wars.

We are currently working on a patch for the problems reported by our users, including problems related to online multiplayer, or investigating the cause of the problems.
We plan to update the software one by one, starting with those bugs for which the cause has been identified and are ready to be fixed.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could update to the latest version before playing the game.

We would appreciate it if you could report any problems to the following thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328310/discussions/0/6252749165563847264/

Thank you for your continued support of CUSTOM MECH WARS.

Team CMW

notes.title: About supported game controllers
notes.content:
Thank you for playing CUSTOM MECH WARS.

This game is compatible with the XB series controllers as well as keyboard mouse, PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, and Switch Pro Controller. If your gamepad input is not responsive or does not work properly, please check the following.

● If you have more than one gamepad connected to your PC, it may not work properly. Please connect only the gamepad you are using.

● Please select "Enable Steam Input" in the Steam Browser settings. The operation may be improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/79a51656e24bff8d580bd1c7f7caa7b29aa5debb.png[/img]

If the above does not improve the problem, we would appreciate it if you could report it in the following Steam thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328310/discussions/0/6252749165563847264/

Team CMW

notes.title: “CUSTOM MECH WARS” Coming THIS WINTER!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/12c4f184c1de63c5038d2dfd4a9ce55d2946dacd.jpg[/img]
Creativity fuels conflict...
A mecha action shooter with Omega Customization options [b]“CUSTOM MECH WARS”[/b] Coming THIS WINTER!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564496/c60652a70447c24ed29c30fcb41cce27790a681c.jpg[/img]

Take customization to the extreme with [b]the Omega Customization System[/b] and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

Freely build mechs with all kinds of designs and parameters, no matter how unconventional—the only limit is your imagination. Take, for instance, the Full Weapon Bot, armed to the teeth with ten rifles and ten missiles; the Asuro Bot, equipped for battle with three heads and six arms; the Motor Bot, mounted with several bazookas; and the Bipedal Tank, a combat vehicle with legs.

Deploy your custom mechs and battle against fleets of oncoming enemies. Collect parts from the destroyed enemies for further customization. Then, take your highly personalized mechs on ever more challenging missions.

The battlefield extends online, where you can join forces with other players to complete co-op missions. Awe your friends with your endlessly imaginative customizations.

Your creativity will throw fuel on the fire of this mecha-based conflict. The grand battle of Omega Customized mecha starts here!
